comparison.objective: Place a pin at the point equidistant from three survey marks; candidate tunes damper response.
comparison.physical_skill: Spatial measurement and precise point placement differs from tool-mediated adjustment, counterholding, and repeated physical cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Pin equidistance versus energy absorption within stroke, rebound, overload, hard-stop, and retention limits. Record has no body/spec rubric.
comparison.reason: Both may require iteration, but they test different physical abilities and outcomes.
